_comment: Hollowgate Reserve: a fenced wildlife park behind Greyreach, run by a smuggling ring (scripts/core/Reserve.gd). The entry fee buys a run of 'sightings' and a limited number of Echo 'calls'. No fighting inside: per sighting you may set bait (calmer, harder to reach), rattle the fence (keener, but jumpier), make an Echo call (the usual Echo minigame, no odds shown) or move on. A Spirling may slip away after each action. The ring's lookout sometimes tips off a rival crew, which spooks one sighting (snitch_chance): only that sighting is lost.
welcome: Velvet Dorran: Welcome to Hollowgate Reserve. Totally legal. The fence is to keep the paperwork in.
Velvet Dorran: No fighting in my yard. You set bait, you rattle the fence, you call. Then you leave and forget my face.
bait_line: You set down a twist of dried bait. %s sniffs it and calms down.
rattle_line: You rattle the fence. %s's ears shoot up: curious, and very jumpy.
fled_line: %s slips through a hole in the fence. The ring will patch that hole. Someday.
snitch_line: A whistle from the lookout tower. A rival crew bursts out of the reeds and %s bolts. Somebody got paid tonight.
bonded_line: %s answers your call and pads over to you. Dorran pretends not to notice.
missed_line: %s tilts its head at your call, but stays put.
done_line: Velvet Dorran: Time's up. Out you go, and the gate never saw you.
